versions.title: First evidence update: nominee odds from primary polling; Khanna, Walz, Ramaswamy added
versions.summary: The model adopts the mechanical proposal's nominee odds, which track primary polling with Harris leading the Democratic field and Vance dominating the Republican field, and keeps the wide two-year-out uncertainty. A draft campaign for Ro Khanna, Tim Walz's presence in the Democratic field, and Vivek Ramaswamy's in the Republican field justify small named entries drawn from 'Other'. No state adjustments are made; the single Nevada state poll is already absorbed by the lean update.

changes.reason: Primary polling (36 polls) implies Harris 0.29, Newsom 0.14, Buttigieg 0.09, with a large uncommitted share; the proposal's odds are retained.
